text:
rory-partner: Kickoff for NovaTech marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for IAM/KMS snippets, legal addendum (KMS rotation + SOC2 callout), SKU manifest, staging screenshots, and a co-marketing timeline. Volunteers?

lina-cloud: I'll produce IAM templates + short how-tos for publisher assume flows across the three clouds. Expect PR w/ snippets by Tue afternoon.

ben-legal: I'll draft the marketplace addendum. NovaTech asked for explicit customer-key custody + 90-day rotation. Need final SKU IDs to reference in the clause.

eva-product: I'll own SKU naming and trial packaging. Draft names: ["nova-core", "nova-dedicated", "nova-private-trial"]. Will upload CSV and pricing bands by Mon.

omar-ops: Trials need metadata: duration, seat cap, auto-expire flag, and support contact. Also confirm telemetry sharing is ok with partner.

kali-eng: I'll build staging screenshots and a 60s demo GIF. Request staging publisher creds from @rory-partner.

rory-partner: Partner OK on anonymized telemetry. Sending staging creds via secure channel. Also partner wants a joint webinar — propose gate public launch on legal sign-off + staging pass.

lina-cloud: Example AWS AssumeRole snippet to include in templates:
```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/NovaPublisher"
  }]
}
```

ben-legal: If SKUs land Mon, I'll finish the addendum by Thu COB. Will include KMS rotation language and audit log access window.

eva-product: CSV uploaded. SKU ids: ["nova-core","nova-dedicated","nova-private-trial"]. Billing note: core = v-tokens.

omar-ops: Support contact for listing: marketplace-support@redwood.com. Trials metadata added to manifest.

kali-eng: Uploaded staging screenshots and demo GIF to the doc.

deploy-bot: New doc created: /docs/marketplace/novatech-manifest-v1.md

rory-partner: Thanks all. Plan: @lina-cloud -> IAM PR by Tue; @eva-product -> finalize SKU CSV by Mon; @ben-legal -> amendment draft by Thu. Sync Wed 9:30am to go over staging pass and webinar dates. :thumbsup:
